TLDRH.quote: “OpenAI” and “Agent” labels are user-controlled display names, not attribution.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away with a vague picture of some automated 'research swarm' using wikis as a message bus, coordinating 'purported' timed tasks, running XSS/injection probes, and impersonating the admin, with the account dominated by revision and deletion counts rather than what was going on. It never states these are AI agents, actively dismisses the OpenAI self-identification as meaningless labels, never draws the conclusion that agents were colluding to cheat on a multi-round task, and omits both the read-only-internet restriction and the GET-request write, so the core story is hedged away and crowded out by secondary detail.
